title: Generated media
unavailable.title: Generated media is not available here
unavailable.body: This workspace client does not provide media jobs. Use a connected administration session.
noRelease.title: Publish a release first
noRelease.body: Generated clips attach to an episode of a published release.
reviewed.title: Nothing generated reaches learners unreviewed
reviewed.body: A finished render is not a teaching artifact. Staff review each clip against the lesson, add captions and a text alternative, and only then attach it as optional help. It never counts as progress or mastery.
release.label: Release
unverified.title: Live generation not verified
unverified.body: This deployment has not verified a real provider render end to end. Treat cost estimates as the operator rate card, not a provider invoice.
jobs.title: Media jobs
jobs.needsPermission: Requesting paid work needs the publish permission.
jobs.empty: No media jobs for this release yet.
requested: Request recorded. Check its state below: a refused request is kept with its reason and nothing is charged.
provider.none.title: No media provider
provider.none.body: Assign a video model to the media role under Providers, with a reviewed rate card.
provider.title: Video generation
request.title: Request a generated clip
request.intro: The clip is generated for one learner's episode and charged to their paid-work allowance. It stays hidden until staff approve and attach it.
request.purposeHint: What the learner should understand from it.
request.scriptHint: Sent to the provider exactly as written. No learner data.
request.estimate: Estimate {estimate}; {reserve} is reserved at admission ({available} available).
job.title: Media job
job.remoteMayContinue: The provider may still finish or bill this operation; cancelling here is local only.
job.cancelled: Cancelled. The reserved allowance is not returned.
review.label: Review this clip
check.factualAccuracy: Facts match the lesson and its reference computation
check.labelsAndEquations: Labels, values and equations are exact
check.captionsMatchNarration: Captions match what is said and shown
check.noMisleadingMotion: Motion does not imply a wrong cause or order
review.captionsHint: Required. At least one timed cue.
review.transcriptHint: Required text alternative of everything said.
review.descriptionHint: Required for learners who cannot see it.
review.approved: Approved. It is still hidden until attached.
review.rejected: Rejected. It will never be shown.
attach.label: Attach as optional help
attach.daysHint: 1 to 180 days. Publication is re-checked against current course policy.
attach.done: Attached as optional help for this learner.
revoke.label: Revoke attachment
revoke.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Learners stop seeing the clip at once.
revoke.done: Revoked. Learners no longer see it.
review.captionsLanguageHint: Learners' players label the caption track with this language.
requestedClip: Exact clip requested. It is rendered on this server and then waits for review. Nothing is charged.
provider.retentionHours: Keeps each result for {hours, number} hours. Course Core saves its own copy as soon as a job finishes, so nothing is lost when the provider deletes it.
provider.retentionNone: Keeps no copy. The result comes back with the request and Course Core stores the only copy.
clips.title: Exact clips from course visuals
clips.ready: Ready. {count, plural, one {One verified course visual} other {# verified course visuals}} can be rendered frame by frame into a video clip on this server, at no cost.
clips.noVisuals: This release has no course visuals to render.
clips.toolchainMissing: Not set up on this server. An administrator sets CLIP_RASTERIZER_PATH and CLIP_FFMPEG_PATH (see the API README) and restarts the API.
request.mode.clip: An exact clip of a course visual (no cost)
request.introClip: The clip is rendered from a verified course visual, frame by frame, so it shows exactly what learners see. It stays hidden until staff approve and attach it.
request.fromShot: Making one shot of the storyboard "{title}".
request.promptHint: Sent to the image model exactly as written. No learner data.
request.clipShowsHint: In your words. The automatic check compares the review with it.
request.clipFree: No cost: rendered on this server from the verified visual.
reference.label: Check against a course visual (optional)
reference.hint: The automatic check compares what the media shows with the values this visual shows.
clip.length: The visual is {seconds, number} s long.
clip.rangeInvalid: The start must be before the end, and both inside the visual.
job.sceneSource: Rendered from "{visual}", {from, number} s to {to, number} s.
review.altTextHint: Required. Describe what the image shows for learners who cannot see it.
checkImage.labelsAndEquations: Labels, values and equations are exact
checkImage.captionsMatchNarration: The alt text matches what the image shows
checkImage.noMisleadingMotion: Nothing in the image suggests a wrong fact
checkPanel.intro: Before saving, check the text above against the approved script, the storyboard shot and any course visual. Approval runs this check again.
checkPanel.useModel: Also ask the AI reviewer (paid, charged to this learner's allowance)
checkPanel.contradicted: If the media really shows this, reject it. Approval will be refused.
checkPanel.consistent: Nothing contradicts the sources. You still confirm each check yourself.
storyboards.title: Storyboards
storyboards.intro: A storyboard splits a clip into shots: generated video or exact clips of course visuals. A reviewer approves it before any shot is made, then the approved clips are joined into one.
storyboards.drafting: The AI is drafting the shots. Reload in a moment.
storyboards.draftFailed: The AI could not draft usable shots. Nothing was charged if it never ran. Write the shots yourself with Edit shots.
storyboards.byModel: Drafted by AI, checked by staff.
storyboards.approved: Storyboard approved. Its shots can now be made.
storyboards.rejected: Storyboard rejected. Nothing will be made from it.
storyboards.composed: Joining requested. The joined clip waits for review. Nothing is charged.
storyboards.composeNeeds: Every shot needs an approved clip before they can be joined.
storyboards.createTitle: Plan a clip with a storyboard
storyboards.createIntro: Write the teaching script once. Then let the AI split it into shots (it may only use the script), or write the shots yourself. A reviewer approves the storyboard before anything is made.
storyboards.scriptHint: Everything the clip should say and show. No learner data.
storyboards.howModel: Let the AI draft them (paid, charged to this learner's allowance)
storyboards.created: Storyboard saved as a draft. A reviewer approves it next.
storyboards.createdModel: Draft ready. Check the shots, edit them if needed, then ask a reviewer to approve.
shot.sceneLabel: Exact clip of "{visual}", {from, number}–{to, number} s:
shots.label: Shots
shots.kindScene: Exact clip of a course visual
